body: emily install --system --write and --iduna-systemd --write run. Service files written to ~/.config/systemd/user/. API key already resolved via emily-secrets.env (config.Resolve fallback). obs-watcher included in emily-system.service via emily start. Needs: systemctl --user enable --now iduna.service emily-system.service (user session required).
title: S29-01/02/03/04: Production systemd services — emily-system + iduna + obs-watcher
